mathematics.assertion_tested: Post-hoc FLOAT64 MILP lower-bound/incumbent estimates on exactly the four CLOSED P47 graphs, compared only with archived observed costs; no partitions exported and no P48/training use.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer graph data; binary vertices, continuous edge epigraphs; SciPy/HiGHS float64 solving, not exact or interval-certified bounds
mathematics.conventions: Undirected positive edges i<j counted once; sum x=N/2,x0=1; z>=plus/minus(xi-xj); min sum wij*z. Gap fields are to estimated solver lower bounds, not known distances from optimum.
inputs: Frozen summary and primary manifest copies pinned by exact SHA256; no P48 graph or primary raw changed
non_claims: No quantum advantage, new guide, positive acceptance or held-out result
No solver partition, mask, assignment or partition hash exported
No use of scalars for P48 or future training/selection
A gap to an estimated lower bound is not a proved distance from optimum

randomness.generator: No instance or sampling RNG; HiGHS deterministic single-thread configuration with fixed solver random_seed

resource_note: PREPARED, NOT EXECUTED. Explicit coordinator slot authorization after this preregistration commit is required. Runner CPU25/wall40/thread1/log1MiB, each of4 MILP calls5s; retain all partial/time-limited/failing cases, no automatic retry. No hard macOS affinity or memory cap assumed.
